title: Employment rate of recent VET graduates
description: Employment rate of 20–34-year-olds, not in education or training, whose highest qualification is vocational upper-secondary or post-secondary (ISCED 35/45), obtained 1–3 years before the survey.
source_label: Employment rates of young persons not in education and training by educational attainment level and years since completion of highest level of education
comparability: From the EU Labour Force Survey; same definition as the EU target indicator.

flags.bu: break in time series, low reliability
flags.bd: break in time series, definition differs (see metadata)

provenance.citation: Eurostat (edat_lfse_24), Employment rates of young persons not in education and training by educational attainment level and years since completion of highest level of education. Retrieved via the Eurostat Statistics API.

target.label: EU-level target: at least 82% by 2025 (Council Recommendation on VET, 2020)
